description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_StrictBlockquote, which modifies blockquote child element validation behavior in HTML purification, including handling inline elements and validation logic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_StrictBlockquote
classes.description: A class that handles validation and reformatting of blockquote child elements in strict HTML purification mode, allowing inline content and managing element boundaries.

methods.name: getAllowedElements
methods.description: Returns the set of allowed elements when validating children, based on current configuration.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates and possibly rewrites the child tokens within a blockquote to ensure conformity to strict HTML rules.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the object with the appropriate set of real and fake elements based on the configuration, only once.
